medications.name: Oxycodone
medications.frequency: Every 4-6 hours as needed for severe pain
medications.instructions: Take with food to prevent nausea. Do not drive while taking this medication.

medications.name: Ibuprofen
medications.instructions: Take scheduled around the clock for the first 3 days to manage inflammation.

restrictions.rule: Keep dressing clean and dry. You may shower after 48 hours but wrap the knee in plastic.
Begin passive knee extension. Do not force flexion past 90 degrees.

warning_signs.action: Go to the Emergency Room immediately

warning_signs.implication: Potential infection at the surgical site
